bio: I'm a software engineer based in Honolulu, currently working on developing flight and ground software for small satellites. My interests span embedded systems, human-computer interaction, and machine learning for space and Earth science.

education.institution: University of Hawaii at Manoa, Manoa, HI
University of Hawaii at Manoa, Manoa, HI

highlights: Developed mission-critical embedded software in C/C++ for a CubeSat platform, including custom RF communication protocols and sensor/payload interfaces integrated under strict power, memory, and real-time constraints.
Engineered a telemetry and command (T&C) system for RF communication between embedded platforms using COTS radios and antennas; validated over a 1-mile ground-to-air link in field testing.

Wrote automated on-target and script-based tests exercising embedded software through command-driven self-tests, characterizing RF link behavior and catching protocol and integration bugs early in development.

Developed embedded Linux user-space software on Raspberry Pi payload computer and debugged microcontroller firmware via GDB/PlatformIO and bootloader recovery, interfacing custom electronics over UART, I2C, and SPI.

work.company: Academia Sinica Institute for Astronomy and Astrophysics
work.summary: Internship through the Akamai Workforce Initiative
highlights: Built a real-time monitoring system for a remote instrumentation site using Prometheus, InfluxDB, and Grafana to track power, voltage, and system health.
Processed and visualized RF signal data (FFT spectra, waterfall plots) to support anomaly detection and system diagnostics.
Implemented an automated Slack-based alerting pipeline for anomaly detection, enabling rapid response to hardware and system faults.

work.company: UH Manoa - College of Social Sciences
highlights: Supervised Mac and PC computer labs, provided technological assistance for students and instructors, acting as a bridge between the IT department and the students and instructors in the classroom
Troubleshoot various technologies, improving resolution times and strengthened interpersonal skills

Developed and delivered a 1-week lesson plan to enhance student understanding and engagement, reinforcing foundational computer science concepts using Java
Held office hours and strengthened communication and teaching skills by presenting complex topics in diverse, accessible ways
